description: A representation of the isospin of a nuclear level.  If there is more than one entry in the array, it can have one of two meanings.  If isIsospinMixture is true, then the isospin is a mixture of the given values.  Otherwise, the isospin of the state is one of the values given in the array.

stringRepresentation.description: This is the ASCII representation of the isospin, similar to what would be printed in Nuclear Data Sheets.
